commits.message:
Add explanatory figures for the guides [skip ci]

Add eighteen self-contained SVG figures under assets/figures: why PID separates
equal totals, the two-source lattice and its events, a worked AND gate, KSG
neighbor geometry, the event order, what shared exclusions is and is not, equal
synergy with different added information, the third-source budget, the
independent label, plug-in convergence, DC-1 under a dependency coloring,
event-to-atom bounds, the two continuity routes, the theorems on a real
population, the pipeline and its refusals, the exact atom sign, the exact local
KSG term, and order-independent exact accumulation.

Each file embeds subset fonts with their license metadata and has an opaque
background, a title and a description. No other file changes.

Enlarge figure text and drop external file references [skip ci]

otherwise unchanged.
